findings.title: Potential Prompt Injection: Unsanitized urllib
findings.description: Function fetches external data (HTTP request via urllib) and may return it without sanitization. This could enable indirect prompt injection if the external source is compromised.
findings.recommendation: Implement input validation and sanitization for all external data. Consider using allowlists, stripping HTML/markdown, and validating structure.
